context: An elderly couple reminisces about old friends over tea
purpose: Teach: もっぱら/それなのに/いやぁ/おもっ/しょっちゅう/時折/一口/出番

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ねえあなた、最近もっぱら昔のことばかり思い出すのよ。お茶、一口どうぞ。
lines.en: You know dear, lately I've been doing nothing but remembering the old days. Have a sip of tea.
lines.style: Warm, nostalgic grandmother voice, soft and unhurried.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: いやぁ、ありがとう。そういえば田中君、しょっちゅう家に来ていたなあ。
lines.en: Oh thank you. Come to think of it, Tanaka used to come over all the time, didn't he.
lines.style: Gentle elderly man, reflective and slightly chuckling between phrases.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ええ、本当に紳士的な方だったわね。長所をたくさん持っていらして。
lines.en: Yes, he really was such a gentlemanly person. He had so many good qualities.
lines.style: Fond, admiring tone with a touch of gentle laughter.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: それなのに、最後の同窓会ではなぜか出番がなくてね。時折、申し訳なく思っていたよ。
lines.en: And yet, for some reason he didn't get a turn to speak at the last reunion. From time to time I've felt sorry about it.
lines.style: Slightly rueful, slower pace with a sigh in the middle.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: あの方はずっと、滋賀のご実家のことを話したがっていたのにねえ。
lines.en: He had been wanting to talk about his family home in Shiga for the longest time, hadn't he.
lines.style: Sympathetic, gently lamenting with quiet warmth.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: そうだったな。私もずっと、もう一度会いたいとおもっていたんだ。
lines.en: That's right. I too had been thinking I wanted to see him one more time.
lines.style: Wistful, voice trailing softly at the end of the line.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 今度、お墓参りに行きましょうよ。お好きだった和菓子も持って。
lines.en: Let's go visit his grave sometime. Let's bring the Japanese sweets he loved too.
lines.style: Tender and resolved, with gentle determination in her voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: うん、そうしよう。さあ、もう一口お茶をいただこうかな。
lines.en: Yes, let's do that. Now then, I think I'll have another sip of tea.
lines.style: Soft, content closing tone with a small smile audible in the voice.
